app.name: Skylog
app.tagline: See, find, log and learn the night sky

sensor.ar: Point phone at the sky (sensor mode)
sensor.unsupported: Orientation sensors are not available in this device/browser. Drag to look around. (Settings → Developer → Sensor simulator lets you test the flow.)
sensor.anomaly: Compass interference suspected — move away from metal or magnetic cases
sensor.simulatorHint: Emulate phone attitude with alpha/beta/gamma sliders on desktop.

permission.deniedHelp: Orientation permission was denied. The app keeps working in manual mode.
permission.deniedIosSteps: iOS: fully close the Safari tab (or home-screen app), reopen it and tap this button again. If it still fails, delete this site's data in Settings › Safari › Advanced › Website Data and retry. (There is no separate toggle in the Settings app.)

geo.unsupported: This browser has no geolocation. Enter an observing site manually.
geo.denied: Location permission denied. Allow it in the browser site settings or enter a site manually.
geo.timeout: Could not get a location (timeout). Try again with a clear view of the sky.
geo.unavailable: Location is unavailable right now. Using the saved site.

wizard.title: Star alignment
wizard.step1: Pick a bright object that is easy to see right now.
wizard.noCandidates: No bright object is high enough right now. Use Polaris or the Moon if visible.
wizard.step2: Point the back of the phone at it so it sits in the crosshair, then tap 'Aligned'.
wizard.dragHint: Drag left/right to fine-tune azimuth, up/down for altitude (0.5° steps).
wizard.done: Calibrated on {{target}}. Check that other objects land near the crosshair.

settings.declinationHint: Applies the WMM2025 declination to absolute (magnetic) headings. Currently {{d}}°
settings.keepLevelHint: Ignore device roll so the horizon stays level.

sites.title: Observing sites
sites.name: Name (e.g. balcony)
sites.rangeHint: Drag on the ring to mark the azimuths actually visible from this spot (balcony, yard). Recommendations only consider this range.

settings.title: Settings
settings.nightModeHint: Turns the whole UI red to protect dark adaptation.
settings.keepAwakeHint: Prevents the screen from sleeping while observing (Wake Lock).
settings.debugHudHint: Shows fps, frame time and draw calls.
